text: ……落ち着かれました？
trans: ......Sir, are you quite alright?

name: ツバサ王子
text:
……ああ……すみません、あなたにぶつかって……
そのまま……
trans:
......Ah, yes...... My apologies for bumping into you......
I shall, find my own feet......

name: ツバサ王子
text:
……ありがとう。……少し、疲れていて……
……この場の空気に酔ってしまったみたいだ
trans:
......Thank you. ...I have been, somewhat fatigued......
I fear the very atmosphere has made me light-
headed.

name: 円香
text:
まあ、無理もありません
こんなに私欲に塗れた場所では
trans:
Indeed, that is understandable.
For this place is steeped in self-desire.

name: ツバサ王子
trans: Pardon......?

name: 円香
text:
皆様が楽しまれている絵画も、宝飾も、焚かれた香木も……
……その全てが
trans:
These paintings, the gilded ornaments, even the
burning incense wood in which everyone indulges......
Every single one.

name: 円香
text:
奪われた人の涙で磨き上げられて、見事に輝いていることを
どれほどの方がご存じでしょうか
trans:
For each of these to shine so brightly, how many
tears have been shed by those who were plundered.
How many would even care to know.

name: 領主
text:
──殿下、ご体調はいかがですかな
部屋を用意してありますから、案内させましょう
trans:
──Your Highness, you look quite pale. 
I have guest chambers ready; would you like to retire
for the evening?

name: ツバサ王子
text:
ありがとう。助かるよ
そちらの方の介抱のおかげで、だいぶ楽にはなった
trans:
Thank you, that is most appreciated.
The lady here has tended to me and I am already
faring much better.

name: 領主
text:
いや……恐れ入ります
何せ予告状が届いた件で、会場が騒然としておりましたから
trans:
Not at all... you grace us, your highness.
Truthfully, the halls have been in quite a stir since
we received a calling card.

name: ツバサ王子
text: 予告状？
trans: A calling card?

name: 領主
text:
怪盗からですよ。『貴族の宝を正す義賊』などと
民草は面白おかしく囃し立てておりますが……
trans:
From a phantom thief. "A righteous thievary of the
aristocrats' riches", they claim. The common folk
cheer them with a certain nonchalance, but....

name: 領主
text:
おかげで警備をいつも以上に強化するはめに──
今夜は安心してお休みいただけるかと……ははは
trans:
Well, we've doubled the guard in light of it──
Please rest in assurance tonight...... hahaha.

name: ツバサ王子
text:
……貴族の宝を正す、か……
だったら『王子』を……この肩書きを正してくれ……
trans:
...The aristocrats' riches for righteousness, huh...
Then why not... turn this title of "Prince" to one of
righteousness as well......

name: ツバサ王子
text: 俺にはこの場所は……眩し過ぎるんだ……
trans: This place is simply...... too dazzling for me......

name: 円香
text: ──美しいものは、あるべき場所に
trans:
──Beautiful things belong where they may be
admired;

name: 円香
text: それが私の美学
trans: Such is my aesthetic.

name: 円香
text:
夜風が気持ちいいですね
酔いは覚めましたか？
trans:
The night wind feels comfortable, does it not.
Have you sobered at last, Your Highness?

name: ツバサ王子
text: ……あなたは……

name: 円香
text:
ミスター・プリンス
あなたを正すなんておこがましい
trans:
Mr Prince,
it would be presumptuous of me to set you 'right'.

name: 円香
text:
……ですが、その翼をここで錆び付かせてしまうのも
退屈ですから
trans:
......But it would have also been a dreadful bore to let
wings such as yours rust in a place like this.

name: 円香
text:
──これは、私からの
ほんの気まぐれ
trans:
──Consider this nothing more,
than a whim of mine.
